reference.use: Independent comparison only; no reference text substituted into extraction.

normalization: Normalize curly quotes to straight quotes
Remove soft hyphen and paragraph marker U+00B6

psalmHeadingHandling.rule: For comparison only, prepend the independently extracted chapter heading to Psalm verse 1. Join physical heading lines with spaces, except immediately after an existing compound hyphen. Keep the import verse text and heading metadata separate.

sourceEditionDifferences.rule: Retain source PDF forms. Accept only each explicitly audited reference and exact source-to-publisher form difference; preserve full differences below.

differences.extractedText: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
differences.publisherText: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we can not deny it.

differences.extractedText: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
differences.publisherText: For we can not but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

differences.extractedText: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
differences.publisherText: But if it be of God, ye can not overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

differences.extractedText: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
differences.publisherText: And what soever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

differences.extractedText: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
differences.publisherText: And what soever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

differences.extractedText: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
differences.publisherText: Where unto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

differences.extractedText: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
differences.publisherText: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise can not be hid.

differences.extractedText: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
differences.publisherText: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, where unto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

differences.extractedText: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
differences.publisherText: Where unto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

differences.extractedText: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
differences.publisherText: Where in I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

differences.extractedText: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
differences.publisherText: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he can not deny himself.

differences.extractedText: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
differences.publisherText: Where in God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

differences.extractedText: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
differences.publisherText: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we can not now speak particularly.

differences.extractedText: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
differences.publisherText: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: but he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
